chapter_title_en: The Treachery of the Evergreen Sword Immortal
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 551: The Evergreen Sword Immortal’s Cold Betrayal
chapter_meta_description: In the heat of the Realm War, Daofather Crimsonbright warns of an imminent threat. But the deadliest blow comes from within, as the Evergreen Sword Immortal commits an act of treacherous murder that will shake the Three Realms.
og_title: A Sword Through the Heart: The Betrayal in Chapter 551
og_description: The Realm War’s tension reaches a boiling point. With a single, cold sword stroke, a Celestial Immortal commits the ultimate betrayal, transforming a strategic stalemate into a devastating personal tragedy.
twitter_title: The Coldest Cut in the Realm War
twitter_description: A trusted ally reveals his true colors on the battlefield. The Evergreen Sword Immortal’s sudden treachery in Desolate Era Chapter 551 is a masterclass in Xianxia heartbreak and betrayal.

lore_anchors.definition: A cold, sharp-tongued Celestial Immortal and fellow disciple of the Xia Emperor known for his solitary, sword-like heart.
A petite, white-robed Celestial Immortal who harbored deep, unrequited feelings for the Evergreen Sword Immortal.
The core energy nucleus of a Pure Yang True Immortal; its destruction is instant death for a Ki Refining cultivator.
A massive battle formation composed of 1,000 Celestial Immortals and 100,000 Loose Immortals.
A powerful divine beast often used in immortal-demon warfare; one was commanded by a True Immortal in this battle.
A Celestial Immortal and the ruler of the Grand Xia Dynasty, bound by deep ties of sect loyalty to his fellow disciples.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the Evergreen Sword Immortal kill the Snowdance Fairy?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The chapter strongly implies he has defected to the Seamless Gate. His cold internal monologue suggests he viewed her merely as a loyal pet, and her death was a necessary sacrifice for his treachery.
A massive battlefield formation typically requiring 100,000 Loose Immortals and 1,000 Celestial Immortals to manifest a temporary, god-tier divine spirit. Ji Ning is a master commander of one.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is the Xia Emperor so angry?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Snowdance Fairy was his fellow disciple and sect sister. He not only witnessed her brutal murder by a trusted ally but also realizes the devastating strategic betrayal and loss of life it will cause.
